author: More Perfect Union
description:
Public outrage over secretive data centers could flip a Senate seat in Louisiana.

Trump-backed data center champion Julia Letlow signed an NDA with Meta for its $50 billion data center, then bought and sold its stock before the deal became public.

Now Democratic candidate Jamie Davis, a Black farmer, is challenging Letlow and calling for a data center moratorium.

Producer: @wadrewhawkins
Editor: @kungaaaaaaaa

title: A Black farmer could oust a Trump lackey in Louisiana over data centers
